name: Futari wa P**Cure Max Heart ~Muri Muri?! Ari Ari!! In Jaa Na~i?!~
original_name: ふたりはプ○キュア Max Heart ～ムリムリ?! ありあり!! 淫じゃぁな～い?!～
source:
Nagisa and Hikari were invited to the science room by Honoka one day after school.
"I'm glad you came. I have a special announcement."
The words hung in the tensely silent air.

Could she be about to quit the PreCure team?
Nagisa and Hikari became increasingly worried. Honoka spoke at last.
"Aren't you curious about how babies are made?"

translation:
某天放学后，渚和光被穗乃香邀请到科学教室。
“谢谢你们过来。我有一件特别的事要宣布。”
话语落下，空气紧张而寂静。

她难道要退出光之美少女队伍吗？
渚和光越来越担心。穗乃香终于开口：
“你们不好奇宝宝是怎么出生的吗？”
